# Template catalog — קטלוג התבניות

Hebrew–English LaTeX Studio **v5.4.10**; catalog schema **2**; architecture schema **5**.

This catalog is generated from [the canonical registry](../registry/studio-catalog.json). It lists available recipes and declared acceptance cases; it does not claim that an engine, renderer or visual reviewer has run for the current release. Execution evidence is retained separately.

זהו קטלוג אחד לעברית, לאנגלית ולמסמכים משולבים. בחירת שפה, ייעוד, פריסה ועיצוב נשארת עצמאית, במסגרת המגבלות המוצהרות. קובצי הדוגמה הם נקודת התחלה לעריכה; החלף תוכן ומטא־נתונים לפני מסירה.

Use [the workflow](everyday-workflow.md) to create a project, [the glossary](glossary-he-en.md) to understand terms, and [the developer guide](catalog-development.md) to extend the skill.

## Inspect before creating

Run these read-only commands from the actual skill root:

```bash
python3 scripts/template_registry.py list
python3 scripts/template_registry.py validate --json
python3 scripts/template_registry.py resolve --kind paper --language english --json
python3 scripts/template_registry.py resolve --kind formula-sheet --language hebrew \
  --layout reference-readable --json
python3 scripts/template_registry.py resolve --kind report --component study --component index --json
```

An explicit theme has precedence over a layout default, a template default, then the catalog default. Every choice remains subject to the layout, language and component constraints. `bilingual` requires `--main-language hebrew` or `english`; both languages are available in every profile.

## Document templates

| `--kind` | Purpose — ייעוד | Default layout | Default theme | Advisory content profile |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `note` | סיכום קצר — Short note | `standard` | `reader` | `generic` |
| `general` | מסמך כללי — General document | `standard` | `reader` | `generic` |
| `letter` | מכתב — Letter | `standard` | `reader` | `generic` |
| `report` | דוח — Report | `standard` | `reader` | `report` |
| `technical` | מסמך טכני — Technical document | `standard` | `reader` | `report` |
| `formula-sheet` | דף נוסחאות — Formula sheet | `standard` | `reader` | `formula-sheet` |
| `data-report` | דוח נתונים — Data report | `standard` | `reader` | `report` |
| `annotated-note` | סיכום עם הערות — Annotated note | `standard` | `reader` | `generic` |
| `paper` | מאמר אקדמי — Academic paper | `standard` | `academic` | `generic` |

A kind names a purpose, not a LaTeX class. Native authored declarations below are preserved as written. A layout may replace the selected starter or override a declaration. All five profiles are supported; the two explicit bilingual bases make six language configurations for acceptance coverage.

## Layout presets

| `--layout` | Description | Allowed kinds | Default theme when omitted |
|---|---|---|---|
| `standard` | עימוד רגיל — Standard layout | `note`, `general`, `letter`, `report`, `technical`, `formula-sheet`, `data-report`, `annotated-note`, `paper` | Template/catalog default |
| `reference-compact` | דף עזר צפוף — Compact reference | `formula-sheet` | `reference` |
| `reference-readable` | דף עזר קריא — Readable reference | `formula-sheet` | `reference` |

Preset values are authored settings, never an automatic fit-to-page operation. Reference numerical font sizes use TeX points, not PDF big points. Layout ownership remains in the core hooks and the selected layout extension.

## Presentation choices

| ID | Description | Availability | Source/mode | Caption labels |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reader` | קריאה — Reader | `generator-supported` | [reader_theme.tex](../assets/reader_theme.tex) | `000000`; `normal` |
| `core` | ליבה — Core | `generator-supported` | `none` | `000000`; `normal` |
| `custom` | עיצוב מקומי — Custom | `generator-supported` | `local-file` | `000000`; `normal` |
| `academic` | אקדמי — Academic | `generator-supported` | [academic_theme.tex](../assets/academic_theme.tex) | `000000`; `normal` |
| `reference` | דף עזר — Reference | `generator-supported` | [reference_theme.tex](../assets/reference_theme.tex) | `000000`; `normal` |
| `clean` | בחינות נקי — Clean | `manual-supported` | [clean_theme.tex](../assets/clean_theme.tex) | `000000`; `normal` |
| `legacy-clean` | תאימות לעיצוב נקי — Legacy-Clean | `legacy` | [clean_variant.tex](../assets/clean_variant.tex) | `000000`; `normal` |

Only `generator-supported` choices are accepted by `new_document.py --theme`. `clean` is a direct-input theme and `legacy-clean` inventories a compatibility bundle. They do not add new generator CLI choices. `core` keeps core presentation; `custom` creates an editable local theme skeleton. Choose one presentation policy.

## Optional semantic components

Select an optional component explicitly with `new_document.py --component ID`; repeat the option to combine components. No optional component is copied or loaded by an unselected recipe. Selected components add small original editable specimens, not complete study books or indexes. Both languages and all five profiles retain the document's own shell.

| `--component` | Purpose | Owned source | Supporting files |
|---|---|---|---|
| `study` | תרגילים ופתרונות — Exercises and solutions | [study_components.tex](../assets/study_components.tex) | None |
| `index` | מפתח עניינים — Subject index | [index_components.tex](../assets/index_components.tex) | [index.ist](../assets/index.ist) |

### Component study

**תרגילים ופתרונות — Exercises and solutions**.
Allowed kinds: `note`, `general`, `letter`, `report`, `technical`, `formula-sheet`, `data-report`, `annotated-note`, `paper`.
Allowed layouts: `standard`, `reference-compact`, `reference-readable`.
Language profiles: `hebrew`, `english`, `hebrew-with-english`, `english-with-hebrew`, `bilingual`.

Guides: [exercises-and-solutions.md](../references/exercises-and-solutions.md), [template-catalog.md](../references/template-catalog.md).

## Documentation maintenance

Required catalog vocabulary: [registry](glossary-he-en.md#term-registry), [catalog-schema](glossary-he-en.md#term-catalog-schema), [resolver](glossary-he-en.md#term-resolver), [resolved-recipe](glossary-he-en.md#term-resolved-recipe), [provenance](glossary-he-en.md#term-provenance), [copy-plan](glossary-he-en.md#term-copy-plan), [load-plan](glossary-he-en.md#term-load-plan), [recipe-revision](glossary-he-en.md#term-recipe-revision), [hook](glossary-he-en.md#term-hook), [ownership](glossary-he-en.md#term-ownership), [constraint](glossary-he-en.md#term-constraint), [backward-compatibility](glossary-he-en.md#term-backward-compatibility), [composer](glossary-he-en.md#term-composer), [source-handler](glossary-he-en.md#term-source-handler), [ragged-alignment](glossary-he-en.md#term-ragged-alignment), [word-hyphenation](glossary-he-en.md#term-word-hyphenation).

To regenerate both this catalog and the maintained glossary, run `python3 scripts/generate_studio_docs.py`. `--check` validates source records, references, glossary coverage, the current release version and exact generated bytes without writing. It is a documentation check, not a build or visual approval.
